annotations.title: x402 finder: search paid APIs, ranked and live-checked

description: Search and discovery of paid x402 API endpoints for a plain-language need, across Ultravioleta DAO x402 Bazaar and 402 Index directories. Dedupes by resource URL; ranks by relevance, verification, uptime, price and recency. Each result: resource URL, short description, USDC price, CAIP-2 networks, sources, verification. The top 3 GET endpoints get a live unpaid check: valid x402 402, live price, networks, canonical USDC, risk flags, OFAC SDN payTo screen, RDAP domain age. Price: $0.01 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

max_price.description: Highest acceptable price per call in USD as a decimal, e.g. 0.01. Listings without a USDC price are left out when set.

network.description: Only endpoints that accept canonical USDC on this network.

q.description: What the agent needs, in plain words, 2-120 characters (e.g. weather forecast for a US city, token price, web page to markdown).
